prompt: Use the codex-invoke skill to implement a login form in src/public/auth/login.html with email and password inputs, form validation, and API integration to the /api/auth/login endpoint. Store the JWT token in localStorage.

assertions.name: email_input_present
assertions.description: Email input field is present in the form

assertions.name: password_input_present
assertions.description: Password input field is present in the form

assertions.name: api_integration
assertions.description: Form submits to /api/auth/login endpoint via fetch

assertions.name: token_storage
assertions.description: JWT token is stored in localStorage after successful login
